titulo: Ideal heat shields could boost solar panels' annual energy output
resumo: Solar panels are designed to absorb most of the incident light. Only part of the absorbed light is converted into electricity; the rest excites vibrations in the crystal lattice, which means it is converted into heat. An ideal heat shield for solar cells should reflect the unusable infrared components of the incident light while, at the same time, allowing all components of the light spectrum that can be converted into electrical energy to pass.
